answer: ram gets up early every morning. his mother cooks food in the kitchen. he is drinking tea right now. ram does not eat meat. his father is not reading the newspaper. does ram go to school daily? yes, he goes to school by bus. he is not picking up his bag right now. where does his brother live? he lives in delhi and is talking on the phone right now.
